label: In the month before the Coronavirus outbreak, how many portions of fresh fruit and vegetables did you eat in a typical day - Covid wave 1 (age 74 years)
meta_rows: In the month before the Coronavirus outbreak, how many portions of fresh fruit and vegetables did you eat in a typical day - Covid wave 1 (age 74 years)

A portion of fruit could be a whole piece of fruit, like an apple or banana or 80g of fruit. A portion of veg is 3 heaped tablespoons of cooked vegetables or beans. Does not include potatoes. Questions about smoking, drinking alcohol, exercise, diet and sleep
